About

Arash Labaf is an Iranian-Swedish singer, songwriter and producer. Born in Tehran in 1977, he moved to Sweden as a child and broke through in 2004 with “Boro Boro”. In 2009 he represented Azerbaijan at the Eurovision Song Contest with “Always”, together with AySel, and finished third.
